title: Neural Functionally Generated Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2506.19715v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a novel neural-network-based approach to learning the generating function $G(\cdot)$ of a functionally generated portfolio (FGP) from synthetic or real market data. In the neural network setting, the generating function is represented as $G_{\theta}(\cdot)$, where $\theta$ is an iterable neural network parameter vector, and $G_{\theta}(\cdot)$ is trained to maximise investment return relative to the market portfolio. We compare the performance of the Neural FGP approach against classical FGP benchmarks. FGPs provide a robust alternative to classical portfolio optimisation by bypassing the need to estimate drifts or covariances. The neural FGP framework extends this by introducing flexibility in the design of the generating function, enabling it to learn from market dynamics while preserving self-financing and pathwise decomposition properties.

translated_title: 神经函数生成投资组合
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.19715v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：我们引入了一种基于神经网络的新方法，用于从合成或真实市场数据中学习函数生成投资组合（FGP）的生成函数$G(\cdot)$。在神经网络设置中，生成函数表示为$G_{\theta}(\cdot)$，其中$\theta$是一个可迭代的神经网络参数向量，$G_{\theta}(\cdot)$被训练以最大化相对于市场投资组合的投资回报。我们将神经FGP方法的性能与经典FGP基准进行了比较。FGP通过绕过估计漂移或协方差的需求，提供了经典投资组合优化的稳健替代方案。神经FGP框架通过引入生成函数设计的灵活性扩展了这一点，使其能够从市场动态中学习，同时保持自融资和路径分解特性。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的函数生成投资组合方法，通过可学习的生成函数直接从市场数据中优化回报，无需估计漂移或协方差，同时保持自融资和路径分解特性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a neural-network-based approach to functionally generated portfolios, learning a flexible generating function directly from market data to maximize returns while preserving self-financing and pathwise decomposition properties, without estimating drifts or covariances.
